{
  "dataset_name": "pricerunner",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "title_char_length",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Total character length of product title, normalized via log1p for smooth linear scaling.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "text_length",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous magnitude signal that varies systematically across product categories with different naming conventions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(product_title.str.len())"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_word_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Number of whitespace-separated tokens in the product title.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "text_length",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Token count gives a smooth continuous feature distinguishing verbose category descriptions from compact ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "product_title.str.split().str.len()"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_digit_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of characters in the title that are digits, useful for detecting model numbers / spec-heavy titles.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "text_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth ratio in [0,1] gives a strong linear separator since categories like CPUs and Phones contain many numeric model identifiers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "product_title.str.count('[0-9]') / np.maximum(product_title.str.len(), 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_uppercase_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of uppercase letters to total characters in original title (acronyms / brand codes).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "text_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear-friendly normalized score capturing acronym density (e.g., CPU model codes, TV).",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "product_title.str.count('[A-Z]') / np.maximum(product_title.str.len(), 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_has_ghz",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the title mentions 'ghz' (clock speed marker).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "keyword_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Strong linear feature for CPU-related products.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(product_title.str.lower().str.contains('ghz', regex=False), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_has_inch",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that title contains 'inch' or a quoted dimension token suggesting display/TV size.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "keyword_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Useful linear signal for TVs and Monitors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(product_title.str.lower().str.contains('inch|\"', regex=True), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_has_kg",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the title mentions 'kg' (typical for washing machines / appliances by load).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "keyword_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear-separable indicator for laundry appliances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(product_title.str.lower().str.contains('kg', regex=False), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_has_freezer_keyword",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the title contains cold-appliance keywords ('fridge', 'freezer', 'frost').",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "keyword_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highly discriminative linear feature for cold-storage appliance groups.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(product_title.str.lower().str.contains('fridge|freezer|frost', regex=True), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_has_camera_keyword",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for camera/photography related keywords in the title.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "keyword_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear signal for camera category.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(product_title.str.lower().str.contains('camera|zoom|megapixel|dslr|lens', regex=True), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_id_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cluster id scaled to [0,1] across observed training range to give a smooth continuous projection.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "id_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized continuous feature; clusters tend to be grouped within categories so order can yield weak linear signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(cluster_id / 47525.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_id_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Vendor id normalized to [0,1] across the observed training range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "id_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized vendor index can act as a weak linear correlate when vendors specialize in categories.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(vendor_id / 368.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_specificity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of how specific/model-like vs generic the product title is, where 0 means very generic descriptive phrase (e.g., 'washing machine') and 1 means highly specific including brand, model number, and specs. Implemented heuristically via weighted composite of digit ratio, uppercase ratio, and token count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite weighted score along directions a linear SVM can leverage to separate generic-titled clusters from model-coded ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.4 * (product_title.str.count('[0-9]') / np.maximum(product_title.str.len(), 1)) + 0.3 * (product_title.str.count('[A-Z]') / np.maximum(product_title.str.len(), 1)) + 0.3 * np.minimum(product_title.str.split().str.len() / 10.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    }
  ]
}
